newsitem.title: INDIA: India foreign portfolio flows down sharply in Aug.
newsitem.headline: India foreign portfolio flows down sharply in Aug.

text.p: Inflows by foreign institutional investors (FIIs) registered on Indian bourses fell sharply to $66.7 million in the first 29 days of August, the Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) said.
Net investments by FIIs in July totalled $302.4 million, Indian market regulator SEBI said.
It did not give reasons for the fall.
It said gross purchases by FIIs upto August 29 totalled 7.54 billion rupees while gross sales were at 5.17 billion.
SEBI said there were 396 registered foreign investors in August, up from 388 in July.
